sentences.text: The known fossils of Serratolamna primarily consist of teeth and scattered vertebrae.
Serratolamna teeth were asymmetrical, featuring smooth crowns and multiple cusplets.
The basal margin of Serratolamna tooth roots was V-shaped.
Based on tooth size, Serratolamna likely grew no larger than 1.5 metres.
Serratolamna lived from the Turonian to the Lutetian stages, between 93.9 and 41.03 million years ago.
Serratolamna fossils have been found in the Late Cretaceous of Cuba, France, Madagascar, Mexico, Morocco, Sweden, and the United States.
